results.title: Rising: Voices of Protest and Hope
results.original_title: Rising: Voices of Protest and Hope
results.overview: A feature documentary about five ordinary people rising from catastrophe to fight for the soul of their homeland. They are part of an unprecedented grassroots uprising—striving to defend democracy, end the bloodshed, bring the hostages home, and uphold Israel’s founding ideals of justice, equality and collective responsibility. In contrast to the headlines and the current extremist government, this film shows the true Israel, rooted in justice, pluralism and the search for peace. Whilst based in Israel, RISING is a universal story. With democracy under siege worldwide, RISING speaks to global struggles over authoritarianism, civic resistance and moral responsibility.

results.original_title: Things Are Lost and Forgotten But Oh My Gosh, They Remain!
results.overview: Two friends are forced to reconcile when one shows up at the other's flat -- after having just run from her own wedding.

results.title: Panopticon 2
results.overview: Alone, in a confined room, a man discovers a surveillance camera watching him.

results.title: Bayam
results.overview: Directed by and starring independent filmmaker and digital creator M.G. Raajavel, Bayam is a Tamil horror-thriller that marks the director's ambitious step into full-length feature filmmaking. Departing from his signature guerrilla-style action and viral comedy sketches, Raajavel weaves a chilling tale that blends intense supernatural thrills with localized, village-centric humor. Under his MGR Production banner, the film features a supporting cast including Dinesh Kumar, Ilavarasi, and Ganesan, set to a haunting score by Niranjan Saravanan.

results.title: Splash
results.overview: Paul is spending a hot summer day with his girlfriend at a public pool – until her charismatic ex-boyfriend appears, igniting a tense triangle of desire and jealousy that pushes Paul to choose between trust and control.

results.title: No One Leaves
results.overview: When Meredith and her husband go to have dinner with their neighbor on the next farm over, he introduces them to his visiting niece. But as the evening progresses, Meredith begins to suspect that this young woman isn't his niece, but his captive.

results.title: Uber For Thomas
results.overview: A mild mannered man's Uber driver shows him how to let loose and enjoy life.

results.title: This gap is (immeasurable)
results.overview: He and she, an improbable couple locking eyes in a provincial train station, become the protagonists of a great centrifugal choreography, crossing through the most genuine cinematic traditions: an urban symphony of the Romanian South, a music video with a fantastic rhythm, a B action-film, and part TikTok doomscrolling.

results.title: Kill. Bury. Print.
results.overview: When the McCurtain Gazette, a small family-run newspaper, begins reporting on alleged sex, drugs, and violence within the county sheriff's office, they find themselves the target of the sheriff's retaliation. Tensions escalate when the paper obtains a secret recording revealing the sheriff and local officials allegedly discussing having the family killed, turning a local investigation into international news.

results.title: The Astronaut
results.overview: After Valentina’s father returns from a space mission, he is unrecognizable.  She tries everything to restore their old relationship.
